# Here are some cool plots

here's a scatterplot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

plot_df = 
  tibble(x = rnorm(100,2,3), y = x + rnorm(100,0,1))

plot_df|>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y))+
  geom_point()
```
